highlights_headline: Upcoming changes improve native callback correctness, Linux shaping stability, and Android frame pacing.

breaking.title: Raise Apple deployment targets
breaking.body: Native SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now require macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Mac Catalyst 14. Managed iOS/tvOS minimums rise to 14; managed macOS 12 and Mac Catalyst 15 minimums stay higher. Raise application deployment targets to the applicable managed/framework floor, not merely the native minimum.

breaking.title: Migrate Uno applications to Uno 7
breaking.body: The Uno views now use Uno 7 and .NET 10; old native-renderer variants and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines are retired. Non-Windows SKSwapChainPanel is a Grid-backed CPU fallback with null GRContext and no RaiseOnUnsupported member; use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering. Windows keeps its ANGLE-backed facade. Use the .NET SDK WASM pipeline and matching product packages.

breaking.title: Keep SKData copy lengths within the source array
breaking.body: SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source array instead of relying on an out-of-bounds native read.

bullets.detail: Disables BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads that advertised GL_RGBA and were invalid in GLES. Readback behavior is unchanged.
Rejects Raster Pipeline slot-count and temporary-stack overflow before allocation, and rejects reserved sampler2D and texture2D runtime-effect types during parsing.
Corrects Skia callbacks to one-byte native booleans and HarfBuzz callbacks to four-byte hb_bool_t values, including false-return handling. Public managed delegates still use bool.

StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode validates the encoded width and decodes one unit correctly: ASCII for UTF-8, BMP for UTF-16, and full code points for UTF-32. GetString(null, encoding) now throws ArgumentNullException rather than NullReferenceException.

Binds internal calls to the bundled HarfBuzz implementation, preventing system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK from redirecting calls between incompatible native objects. Exported entry points and managed signatures are unchanged.

Automatic continuous GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows display callbacks instead of swap throughput. Explicit render requests remain independent, and drawing stays on the GL worker.

Includes emdawnwebgpu C++ support in libSkiaSharp.a instead of compiling it on the application link line, avoiding C/C++ flag conflicts. JavaScript glue remains a link input; newer consumers require matching rebuilt archives.

Managed pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation when direct copying is valid. HarfBuzz UTF-32 string insertion reuses encoding storage, and feature formatting avoids native string allocation while preserving decoding behavior.

Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to a wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. The borrowed stream is not disposed; its caller remains responsible for disposal.

Aligns Windows library dependencies with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 and refreshes the bundled WinUI ANGLE dependency to chromium/8118. These changes do not raise the declared Windows runtime minimum.
